# Functional Expectations

## Session Management

- Coordinators create, edit, publish, cancel, and archive sessions.
- A session includes topic, description, dates, delivery mode, location when
  relevant, capacity, prerequisites, and approval requirement.
- Published sessions are searchable by staff.

## Place Requests

- A staff member requests a place and may provide a short reason.
- Requests requiring approval are sent to the relevant manager.
- Coordinators can see approved requests and current capacity.
- Staff can withdraw a pending or approved request.
- Status changes are visible to the requester.

## Attendance

- Coordinators export an attendance list.
- Coordinators record attendance after a session.
- Staff can see their own completed sessions.

## Administration and Support

- Authorized administrators manage topics and coordinator permissions.
- Support staff can inspect access and notification events.
- Material actions require an audit trail.

Detailed exception flows and acceptance criteria have not been written.
